name: Investment Fund 1
definition: Details about the investment fund class.

FinancialInstrumentIdentification.name: Financial Instrument Identification
FinancialInstrumentIdentification.definition: Identification of the investment fund or investment fund class.

ClassType.name: Class Type
ClassType.definition: Features of units offered by a fund. For example, a unit may have a specific load structure, eg, front end or back end, an income policy, eg, pay out or accumulate, or a trailer policy, eg, with or without. Fund classes are typically denoted by a single character, for example, 'Class A', 'Class 2'.

TotalUnitsOutstanding.name: Total Units Outstanding
TotalUnitsOutstanding.definition: Number of shares outstanding for the investment fund or investment fund share class.

TransactionalUnits.name: Transactional Units
TransactionalUnits.definition: Total transactional units (subscriptions and redemptions) which are applied to the investment fund or investment fund share class for the report period.

TotalValue.name: Total Value
TotalValue.definition: Total value of the investment fund or investment fund share class units.

Price.name: Price
Price.definition: Amount of money for which goods or services are offered, sold, or bought.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that can not be captured in the structured fields and/or any other specific block.
